title: TraitMap
description: How each Moon/Mars target band becomes a test requirement on ONE Earth column, in Earth units (ADR-0005 D2, DATA-PIPELINE.md section 6). One rule per (objective, trait). The engine compares Earth numbers with these bands only. A trait with no rule, or a rule whose band is null, is UNKNOWN for that objective, never skipped and never counted as a match. Cross-file checks (objectiveId exists, earthColumn is a real column of its table, lo <= hi, one rule per pair) live in scripts/validate_contracts.py.

band.description: Earth-unit band. Both ends included (lo <= value <= hi) unless hiStrict, then value < hi. null = no band yet: the trait is unknown for this objective.

source.description: Where a band's number comes from, when it is quoted from a stored file (e.g. #67 filling a null band). The quote must be verbatim in the snapshot.

location.description: Page, table or section in the source.

snapshotPath.description: Path under data/snapshots/ of the stored copy.

table.description: L1 yearly (cells-r4), L1m per month (cells-r4-monthly), L2 context (context-r4). A new table needs a contract PR. null only when there is no Earth column at all.

earthColumn.description: Column of `table`, as named in DATA-PIPELINE.md section 5. Booleans are 0/1.

hiStrict.description: true: value < hi (the source says '< hi'). Default false.

priority.description: must filters sites out; nice is shown and never filters. Default must.

origin.description: target = from a cited envelope in data/envelopes/; precedent = from a cited past campaign; team = our stated choice. 'user' exists only in the app (plan-request bandEdits), never in this file.

campaignId.description: Required when origin is precedent: the data/campaigns/ row the number came from.

basis.description: Plain-English reason for the band and where its number came from.

scaleCaveat.description: How the Earth statistic differs from the target one (grid, statistic, proxy).
